prerequisites: Project for assessment and exam in range of lectures
syllabus_topics: Logic control, logical functions, number system, codes (BCD, Gray)
Theory of finite automaton - introduction
Petri nets - application for industrial processes control
PLCs in distributed control systems, types of PLC and application areas
Function principles of PLC, configuration, HW structure of PLC
PLC software - current situation, basic functions and possibilities
Standard IEC 1131-3: software, program and communication model, common elements of programming languages
Standard IEC 1131-3: standard and derived functions and function blocks, application examples
Standard IEC 1131-3: structuring resource - sequential function diagram (SFC)
Standard IEC 1131-3: graphical programming languages - ladder diagram (LD), function block diagram (FBD)
Standard IEC 1131-3: textual programming languages - instruction list (IL), structured text (ST)
Control applications design - methodology. Software tools for PLC programming, tasks during controlled systems debugging and commissioning.
Systems of PLCs, networking of PLCs, communication possibilities of PLCs
Visualization of industrial processes controlled via PLCs. Human machine interface (HMI). Commissioning and safety requirements.
Course project specification, Case study - education and demonstration robot Festik
Programming tools for PLC systems Teco, Festo, Schneider Electric, Siemens.
Practical examples - basic logic functions, function blocks, sequential functions.
Practical exercise - course project, Case study - Schneider Electric
Practical exercise - course project, Case study - visualization
Practical exercise - course project
Course project presentation, concluding test.
bibliography: Glen A. Mazur;William J. Weindorf. Introduction to Programmable Logic Controllers, Amer Technical Pub; 2nd edition (January 15, 2011)
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
